heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly cloudy near and north of Route 2, with the chance of a shower or thunderstorm; slight chance south of Route 2, under mostly cloudy skies. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, except mid to upper 70s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Chance of an evening shower, mainly in the northern mountains, then partial clearing, except remaining mostly cloudy northeast. Patchy valley fog. Lows from the upper 50s to mid 60s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west and diminishing.

heading: Friday
text: Patchy valley fog early, then variable clouds. Chance of an afternoon shower from the Adirondacks and Route 2 northward, except likely near the Vermont/Québec border. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, some upper 70s far south. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.
